title: Transforming Cities: Activating Buenos Aires
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Activating Buenos Aires,” an urban initiative documented for Buenos Aires. It is included because it is located in the Global South. intervention.objectives: In Buenos Aires, Ramona had to move when the house next door sank due to the neighbourhood’s unstable foundations. She now lives in a community that is actively involved in shaping their surroundings.
intervention.measures:
Ramona had to move when the house next door sank due to the neighbourhood’s unstable foundations. She now lives in a community that is actively involved in shaping their surroundings – from establishing a local organic nursery to mapping out new streets and homes.
